profile.Name: Grey
profile.Personality: An honorable, soft-spoken old Anti-Slaver with a sad smile, who warns recruits that freedom's road is grim and thankless.
profile.Backstory: He recruits for the Anti-Slavers at Spring and welcomes freed slaves.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Quiet, croaking voice; calls everyone 'comrade'; gentle but searching questions.
